objective: Ten primary-paper architecture reproductions without training; incrementally improve an isolated SMPL-H candidate

protocol.inputs: Existing primary texts P02/P03/P04/P05/P07/P09/P10/P12/P14/P16 and author repositories; explicit artificial tensors for untrained forward checks
protocol.control: Keep the current FlowMesh and engineering mainline untouched; compare each original implementation with its own published configuration before project adaptation
protocol.variables: One architecture/interface change per candidate; label reduced sizes, feature-only tests, alternate assets and compatibility patches explicitly
protocol.success: For each of ten papers: method/code anchors, runnable original inference structure or explicitly unresolved resource failure, tensor/coordinate/representation contract, limitations; then verified isolated candidate revisions and architecture synthesis
checks: finite forward output and actual shapes
rotation convention and SO(3) endpoints where relevant
future-dependence and streaming state where applicable
no download of weights during random initialization
protocol.stopping_rules: Stop only the affected test on absent assets/license or numerical failure; preserve evidence and continue independent papers. No training, no random-output accuracy claims, no frozen-mainline replacement, no redistributing external code/assets
protocol.scope_boundary: Architecture reproduction is not replication of published trained performance. A component forward is not a full model forward; project adaptations remain separate from the original architecture. Do not mark the whole goal complete while any requested reproduction or architecture revision remains unresolved.

papers.name: ProHMR
papers.focus: Separate probabilistic pose and deterministic shape; multiview fitting
papers.coverage: Original RGB backbone plus pose-flow/beta/weak-camera head, released 63 random + 1 zero candidates, invertible-flow density roundtrip; original neutral SMPL and full loss/evaluation not run

papers.name: HuManiFlow
papers.focus: Ancestor-conditioned SO(3) pose and shape distributions
papers.coverage: Original ResNet18/23 hierarchical SO(3) flows, shape distribution, weak camera, point/sampling/log-density paths; no detector/edge generation, SMPL neutral mesh or full evaluation

papers.name: HMR2
papers.focus: Image tokens and iterative parameter queries
papers.coverage: Original ViT-H/16 (when enabled) and six-layer Transformer SMPL head; neutral SMPL mesh, detector/crop estimation, checkpoint and full evaluation not run

papers.name: VIBE
papers.focus: Temporal feature encoder and shared clip shape; future dependence
papers.coverage: Original TemporalEncoder only, exact AST class, not complete VIBE/SMPL; bidirectional diagnostic explicitly differs from released configuration

papers.name: WHAM
papers.focus: Causal body motion and separate world trajectory
papers.coverage: Original full Network constructor without body asset, plus original motion encoder, motion decoder, trajectory decoder and missing-point preprocessing. No SMPL mesh/global-feet/refiner execution

papers.name: MotionBERT
papers.focus: Separate spatial and temporal attention; mesh head
papers.coverage: Original pose-lifting network (P12/P14) or velocity network (P03); mesh heads, image detectors, learned accuracy and full evaluation pipelines are not covered

papers.name: MotionAGFormer
papers.focus: Global attention and local spatial/temporal graph branches
papers.coverage: Original pose-lifting network (P12/P14) or velocity network (P03); mesh heads, image detectors, learned accuracy and full evaluation pipelines are not covered

papers.name: FMPose3D
papers.focus: Conditional flow velocity and candidate aggregation
papers.coverage: Original published human velocity network, Euler and exact single-frame flip-TTA method, RPEA input dependency probes; original RPEA evaluation requires GT root. No trained dataset/video/detector/SMPL-H path.

papers.name: LearnableTriangulation
papers.focus: Algebraic/volumetric calibrated view fusion; pinhole boundary
papers.coverage: Original algebraic network, full64cubed volumetric/V2V forward with artificial predicted pelvis, original RANSAC/direct-refinement forward with explicit module-local Python-set compatibility. No original data/checkpoint/center estimator, fisheye adaptation or project strict quality mask.

papers.name: RiemannianFM
papers.focus: Manifold probability paths and tangent vector fields
papers.coverage: Original sphere geodesic/JVP, configured tangent network/loss plus published1000-step projected Euler sample/sample_all; no original dataset likelihood or human SO3.
